card.name: End of drug name before a condition
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or drug-class name (e.g. TAGRISSO, FILSPARI, diuretic, fibrate) in dosing instructions, right where a phrase like 'as needed', 'based on' or 'as soon as possible' follows.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward 'only' or a limiting qualifier, and away from other continuations.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a drug name when a condition or limit on its use is about to follow.
